name: Bhakra Dam
summary: Hypothetical sudden failure of a section of the Bhakra concrete gravity dam, routed past Nangal, Anandpur Sahib and Kiratpur Sahib onto the Punjab plains at Rupnagar.

dem.source: Terrain Tiles (AWS Open Data; SRTM, NASA / USGS), zoom 12, box-filtered to 110 m

notes: Concrete dams fail by monolith collapse, so the breach is set to roughly a third of the crest forming in 15 minutes instead of the Froehlich embankment regression. Figures are approximate public values (BBMB, NRLD).
